problem: Async grant resolution followed by a new-tab anchor required a popup after the original user gesture. Native Safari blocked that Download path.

change.download: Fresh scoped download grant; validated active-environment Storage URL with required attachment flag; temporary same-context anchor, removed immediately; no popup or file buffering.
change.open: Reserve blank tab synchronously, sever opener, navigate only that still-blank owned tab after fresh inline grant.
change.lifecycle: Abort/discard pending grants on SDK, identity scope, environment, reference change or unmount. Errors close only the pending blank tab; an independently navigated tab is preserved.
change.permissions: No backend, Storage policy, SDK permissions or stored credentials changed.

tests.transport: Actual temporary local HTTPS attachment server, exact downloaded-byte equality, synthetic SDK grants and contexts.
cases: Delayed attachment grant downloads without popup and retains app
Open reserves a gesture-bound tab with opener null and inline grant
Blocked Open produces a visible error before requesting a grant
Inline-only grant is rejected for Download
Failed Open grant closes its blank tab
Identity scope change cancels pending navigation
User-navigated reserved tab is not closed or overwritten

limitations: WebKit is not native Safari; native Safari recheck and final rebuilt/deployed smoke remain pending.
Local HTTPS fixture bytes do not claim hosted Storage delivery.
No broad unchanged workflow suite repeated.
